infobox.usage: Unlocks the utility room at the underground parking garage on Ground Zero.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Underground parking utility room key (Utility) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the utility room at the underground parking in the city center.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to the utility room at the underground parking garage at Ground Zero.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Dead Scav
- Wooden ammo box
- Toolbox
- Grenade box
- Weapon box (4x4)
- Weapon box (6x2)
